channel.title: Wildcard Watch: Oracle
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving Oracle, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Patch now: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in Oracle E-Business Suite
item.description:
Oracle E-Business Suite: RCE · exploited · fix available · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Install the security update for Oracle E-Business Suite. The CCB advisory lists the affected and fixed versions.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this and advises to patch immediately. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix.

High · Fix available · CVE-2026-101767

item.title: Act now: Oracle PeopleSoft Enterprise PeopleTools: Missing Authentication for Critical Function
item.description:
Oracle PeopleSoft Enterprise PeopleTools: Authentication bypass · internet-facing · exploited · check vendor

First step: Follow the vendor advisory for Oracle PeopleSoft Enterprise PeopleTools: install the update or apply the mitigation it lists.

Oracle PeopleSoft Enterprise PeopleTools contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to obtain takeover of PeopleSoft Enterprise PeopleTools.

Critical · Check vendor · CVE-2026-35273
